List the hostnames, wildcards, IP addresses, and IP address ranges that Tenable Vulnerability
Management matches against targets in auto-routed scans. For more information about supported
route formats, see Supported Scan Routing Target Formats.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
integer <int32>
The ID of the scanner group. Corresponds to the id  element in the 200
response for the GET /scanner-groups endpoint.
group_id
required
